cc:Work.dc:title: Qwen3.5-9B: codegym transfer
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 1. Agent performance beyond the training environment. Qwen3.5-9B before training and after CodeGym training with GRPO or Dyad-GRPO. Scores (%) on four other environments without further training. Dyad-GRPO annotations show absolute gains (%) over the original LLM.
